title: Segment
description: Represents a curated audience segment — the atomic unit of inventory in the curation protocol. Segments define targetable audiences or contexts through rules managed internally by the curator. They are discovered through the protocol (via get_segments), not created by buyers.

description.description: Detailed description of what this segment targets and its intended use cases

categories.description: Category labels for filtering and organization (e.g., 'sports', 'automotive', 'luxury', 'news')

targeting_summary.description: Plain-language summary of targeting rules (geo, contextual, behavioral, device). The protocol does not expose raw targeting rules — those are internal to the curator.

estimated_daily_impressions.description: Estimated daily available impressions across all supported platforms

estimated_reach.description: Estimated unique users reachable through this segment

supported_platforms.description: SSP platform IDs where this segment can be activated. Cross-reference with list_platforms for platform details.

supported_ad_format_types.description: Ad format types available for this segment

countries.description: Countries where this segment has coverage, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes

devices.description: Device types with coverage for this segment

pricing_guidance.description: Indicative pricing for this segment. Actual deal pricing is set in create_deal.

suggested_cpm.description: Curator's recommended CPM for competitive win rates

version.description: Segment version number. Incremented when the curator updates targeting rules.

brief_relevance.description: Explanation of why this segment matches the brief. Only included when buying_mode is 'brief'.
